title: fix(service-settings)!: remove the Feature Flags page whose four toggles changed nothing
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgGwJpXNreDPXu62S58G5fJZ)_

domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup 里的「功能开关」页整页移除：看板泳道、实时光标、行内评论、AI 助手四个开关，连同这个设置命名空间、它的 Setup 导航入口、四语文案和对外导出 `featureFlagsSettingsManifest` 一起删掉。
- 为什么改：这四个开关没有任何代码读取，管理员打开保存后什么都不会变（ADR-0049 要么兑现要么删除）；四个删完页面只剩一条提示，按您「以上都同意，立卡」的方向整页移除，功能做出来时再把开关带回来。
- 风险与回滚：已存的 `sys_setting` 行和 `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_*` 环境变量留在原处、变成无人读取的惰性数据，不做清理；访问 `/api/settings/feature_flags` 现在答 404。直接 import 该导出的宿主编译会报错（changeset 写明一行修法）。回滚即撤本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/index.ts`（聚合去掉一项）、`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts`（导航条目）、`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.test.ts` 的新钉子 `no longer serves the retired feature_flags namespace`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run src/settings-service.test.ts -t "retired feature_flags"`，预期 1 条通过；或在控制台 Setup → 配置分组里，预期不再出现「功能开关」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #30204

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — removes the four settable keys of the `feature_flags` settings namespace, the then-empty namespace, its Setup entry and the `featureFlagsSettingsManifest` export; nothing is widened
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #30275

## What changes

The card's direction, agreed by the maintainer on filing (「以上都同意，立卡」): "Remove the four toggles, and the settings page if it is left empty. A flag comes back with the feature that reads it." Triage 6648454483 asks to wire each flag or remove it and say which per flag.

**Per flag: all four removed, none wired.** Measured at `origin/main` `5fa9375e` (and re-checked after merging `origin/main` at 1d8e7702a): a `git grep` for `ai_enabled`, `kanban_swimlanes`, `realtime_cursors`, `inline_comments` outside tests and docs hits only the manifest and the service-settings translations. No code under `packages/` or `ui/` reads `feature_flags.*` through the settings service, the settings client or an `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_*` variable.

| Key | Default | Reader found | Disposition |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `ai_enabled` | false | none: the console's AI panel is decided elsewhere (`AppHeader.tsx`'s `topbar.aiAssistant` is a label key) | removed |
| `kanban_swimlanes` | false | none | removed |
| `realtime_cursors` | false | none | removed |
| `inline_comments` | true | none | removed |

The console's `features` map (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`) comes from `/api/v1/auth/config`, not from this namespace, and is untouched. The cloud repository is not readable from this seat, so a reader there is not ruled out; it is said so here and in the report.

**The namespace goes too.** With the four toggles gone the manifest held only a beta banner and two empty groups, so per the ruling the page is removed (seat amendment 03:16Z, Claim 6648715176):

- `@objectstack/service-settings`: `manifests/feature-flags.manifest.ts` deleted; `builtinSettingsManifests` loses it (10 manifests to 9); the `featureFlagsSettingsManifest` export leaves `src/manifests/index.ts` and `src/index.ts`; the `feature_flags` block leaves the en / zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES bundles; README's env-override example moves to `ai.log_prompts`, and its built-in table drops the row; the plugin option's comment names `builtinSettingsManifests` instead of a list.
- `@objectstack/platform-objects`: the Setup entry `nav_settings_feature_flags` and its four locale labels and three source-hash rows are removed, so Setup leaves no link to a namespace nothing serves.
- Texts that named it: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` (11 namespaces to 10, list and variants), `packages/cli/README.md`, `content/docs/protocol/kernel/config-resolution.mdx` (env example now `OS_AI_LOG_PROMPTS`), `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx` (Configuration group row), and comment-only lines in `plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`, `service-datasource/src/admin-routes.ts` and `mcp/src/connect-ui.ts`.

**What happens to a stored value.** Nothing registers `feature_flags` any more, so `SettingsService.getManifest('feature_flags')` throws `UnknownNamespaceError` (`SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE`), a read or write through the service rejects the same way, and the REST door answers `404 UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE`. A `sys_setting` row stored under the namespace and an `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_*` environment variable are left where they are and become inert: no code resolves them. They are not cleaned up; an operator may delete them at will.

The changeset carries the BREAKING banner, both declaration lines, and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (runtime-export-retired @objectstack/service-settings#featureFlagsSettingsManifest)`, verified by the gate (predicates 1 to 3).

## Tests

- New pin in `settings-service.test.ts`, `SettingsService — registry`: with every built-in manifest registered and `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_AI_ENABLED=true` in the env, `builtinSettingsManifests` carries no `feature_flags`, `getManifest('feature_flags')` throws an `UnknownNamespaceError` whose `code` is `SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE`, and `get('feature_flags', 'ai_enabled')` rejects with that code.
- Tests that used the namespace as a convenient boolean toggle now use `ai.log_prompts` (default false) and `ai.trace_enabled` (default true): env coercion, `getNamespace`, the option-table negative case, and `envKeyOf`.
- Count pins moved deliberately, each with its reason: built-in manifests 10 to 9 in `settings-visibility-declaration.pin.test.ts` (96 predicates unchanged: the removed manifest declared no `visible`), `settings-retired-workspace-noun.pin.test.ts` and `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts`.
- `settings-branding-posture.pin.test.ts`: the walled-posture listing control keeps `company` and `localization` (the namespace it also named is gone); the Setup-order control now compares against `nav_settings_lifecycle`, the last platform-objects entry.
- `settings-help-business-words.pin.test.ts` sweeps four namespaces instead of five.

</details>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 1; Test Files 1 failed, 418 passed, 3 skipped (422); Tests 1 failed, 3491 passed, 36 skipped (3528).
- The one red: `test/permission-set-clone-door.dogfood.test.ts` "a platform set (the lock-and-clone rule's commonest source) copies into its shipping package's pair": the clone of `member_default` answers 422 `INVALID_METADATA` ("grants on object 'sys_comment' which is not defined in objects").
- Control leg: every package source file of this diff restored to `origin/main` (19 files), the five touched packages force-rebuilt, the same file run: the same test fails the same way (1 failed, 10 passed). Restored to HEAD afterwards (`git diff HEAD` empty) and rebuilt. So the red is on `main`, not caused by this PR. The `sys_comment` grant on `member_default` came in with 490d136f2 (#30222), before this branch's base.

</details>

## Deviations from the order

- Contract review 6649883787 (must-fix): `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` still counted 11 open-framework namespaces in two places (the `GET /api/settings` step and the `settings-hub-roundtrip` scoring clause); both now say 10, matching the list. Fixed in 8dffea3f7.
- Contract review 6649883787 (should-fix, surface widened by the seat): `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-setting.object.ts` no longer gives `feature_flags` as an example namespace (now `mail, branding, storage`); `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` regenerated `en.objects.generated.ts`, and the zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES help strings were updated by hand (merge mode keeps translated values). Fixed in 8dffea3f7 (source) and 74c2ef826 (bundles).
- Test Core (1/8) red on 1d8e7702a (surface widened by the seat): `packages/cli/test/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts` pins the platform admin's Setup tree; with `nav_settings_feature_flags` gone it is 32 entries, not 33 (both assertions, and the comment's 24 contributions now 23). A grep of every test under `packages/` and `ui/` for `nav_settings_feature_flags` or a Setup entry total found no other pin. Fixed in 8dffea3f7.
- The changeset names the export, not each removed key, on its FROM line: the ADR-0087 `runtime-export-retired` category reads exactly the marker's operands there. The four keys are listed in prose as removed, each with no effect.

Readings on 74c2ef826: `dispatch-gates --commands` 96 derived (the 95 above plus `check:cli-test-child-env`), 96 exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED; `pnpm lint` exit 0; cli unit pins (3 files, 12 tests), platform-objects 1514/1514 + typecheck, plugin-audit / plugin-security nav tests, rest.test.ts 216/216, service-settings setup-nav-hub-parity 9/9, all pass; `check:i18n` and `check:i18n-stale-fill` exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `docs/adr/0007-settings-manifest-and-kv-store.md` still shows `feature_flags.ai_enabled` as its worked example; ADRs are outside this PR's surface and the example stands as the record of the decision.
- `skills/objectstack-platform/references/plugin-development.md:354` names the `feature_flags` manifest as the place for org-tunable toggles; `skills/**` is outside this PR (the `Skills-docs:` line above), the seat files it.
- The `docs.objectos.ai` repository documents `FEATURE_FLAGS_AI_ENABLED`; that text is now false and lives outside this repository.
- `packages/spec` tests (`settings-banner-translation.test.ts`, `customization-package.test.ts`) and the console test `SettingsField.infoBanner-12671.test.tsx` use `feature_flags` as a self-contained fixture string; none reads the removed manifest, and both trees are outside this PR.
- `docs/audits/2026-06-handwritten-docs-accuracy-followups.md:288` cites the old key as an example in a dated audit; left as history.
- Released `CHANGELOG.md` entries that mention `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_AI_ENABLED` are release-owned and unchanged.

The sweep ran on a9be523f; after the merge, these re-ran on 1d8e7702a, all exit 0: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` (verified: `runtime-export-retired @objectstack/service-settings#featureFlagsSettingsManifest`), `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, `spec check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `docs-audit/check-affected-docs`, `check:published-files`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:nul-bytes`, and `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (outside the derivation). `--ran` reconciliation: "95 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 95 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
